#
# deploy.sh - Creates a release archive (tar.gz) of the current directory,
#             excluding node_modules and .git directories.
#

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
PROJECT_NAME=$(basename "$(pwd)")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
ARCHIVE_NAME="${PROJECT_NAME}_release_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"
OUTPUT_DIR="./releases"
